allstarfull.why: One player's appearance in one all-star game, keyed player, year and game number, with the gameID.

appearances.why: A player's games by position for one team in one season, keyed year, team and player.

awardsmanagers.why: One row per award given to a manager in a year and league.

awardsplayers.why: One row per award given to a player in a year and league; points at players.

awardssharemanagers.why: One manager's vote tally in one year's award voting, keyed award, year, league and manager.

awardsshareplayers.why: One player's vote tally in one year's award voting, keyed award, year, league and player.

batting.why: A player's batting statistics for one season stint, keyed player, year and stint.

battingpost.why: A player's batting totals for one postseason round, keyed year, round and player.

els_teamnames.why: Team id, name and park combinations, several per team and none dated; it is neither one row per team nor tied to a season.

fielding.why: A player's fielding statistics at one position for one season stint, keyed player, year, stint and position.

fieldingof.why: A player's outfield games split by field for one season stint, keyed player, year and stint.

fieldingpost.why: A player's fielding totals at one position in one postseason round, keyed player, year, round and position.

halloffame.why: One candidate's ballot result in one year's Hall of Fame vote, keyed hofID and year; players points at it.

managers.why: A manager's record with one team in one season, keyed year, team and in-season order.

managershalf.why: A manager's record for each half of the 1981 split season, keyed year, team, manager and half.

pitching.why: A player's pitching statistics for one season stint, keyed player, year and stint.

pitchingpost.why: A player's pitching totals for one postseason round, keyed player, year and round.

players.why: One row per person with names, birth and death details and ids in other sources; every player table points at it.

salaries.why: A player's salary with one team in one season, keyed year, team, league and player; 28 distinct years.

schools.why: One row per college with name, city, state and nickname; schoolsplayers points at it.

schoolsplayers.why: Which school each player attended, over yearMin to yearMax: a validity span on a player-to-school link, the player's state over time.

seriespost.why: One postseason series in a year, naming the winning and losing team.

teams.why: A team's record for one season, keyed year, league and team; player and manager tables point at it.

teamsfranchises.why: One row per franchise with name, active flag and predecessor association; teams and els_teamnames point at it.

teamshalf.why: A team's record for each half of the 1981 split season, keyed year, team, league and half.
